messages:
deploy-bot: ✅ Deploy finished for release v1.21.3-stg -> staging-nightly. Triggering post-deploy smoke (smoke-suite/fast). Wave config: 3 waves, sample 5% traffic, probe timeout 30s.

maria: Kicking off wave 1 now — small footprint. I’ll watch embed and chat routes primarily.

sam: Wave 1 results: embed-route p95 jumped to ~420ms and a couple of 502s during the 30s window. Grafana: https://graf.redwood/g/abcd/embed-p95 (shortlink).

maria: Hmm. reducing sample to 1% and re-running quick probe. @kevin can you eyeball routing weights and pod health? :eyes:

kevin: Routing looks fine — weights: canary=1%, primary=99%. Pod health: all pods Ready. Logs from model-runner showing intermittent: `InferenceError: kv cache miss` and spikes of `socket timeout` around the same timestamps.

ops-bot: :warning: synth-probe alert — embed-route p95 > 400ms (wave 1). incident-tag=smoke-synthetic, severity=medium.

sam: Quick mitigation: pin embed route to previous model variant v1.21.2 for canary traffic. Applying rollout patch now (`kubectl patch rollout embed-canary -p '{"model_variant":"v1.21.2"}'`).

maria: Patch applied. Re-running wave 1 (1% sample). Quick curl check:```curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"input":"hello"}' https://staging.api.redwood/v1/embed | jq .```  -> no 5xx, p95 ~180ms on this run.

kevin: Also applied temporary runtime tweak: reduced batch size for model v1.21.2 on staging from 64 -> 32 to avoid kv-cache churn. Added note to rollout metadata.

maria: Good. Wave 2 starting in 2m, will monitor 15m after wave 3. Plan: if waves 2+3 show stable p95 < 250ms and no 5xx, increment traffic to 10% and hold.

sam: Filing follow-up ticket INF-3427 to investigate kv cache miss root cause and verify model runner patch.

maria: For release notes: add an entry — "staging: rolled back embed route canary to v1.21.2 after p95 regression; temporary batch size reduction; follow-up INF-3427." I’ll hold final rollout decision until the 15m window completes. :thumbsup:

kevin: FYI I’ll also collect profiler traces during wave 2 and attach to the ticket.

maria: Thanks all — leaving smoke watch active. If anything new pops up ping @oncall.

deploy-bot: Deploy watch: active (smoke-suite/fast). Next check-in will be at 15m mark.
